title: Servo: Building a Parallel Browser
summary: Jack Moffitt presents Servo, an experimental browser engine written in Rust and designed to be parallel at every level, using multiple cores, the GPU, fork-join concurrency and SIMD. The talk covers motivations, architecture and plans for the project.
why: HN commenters cite it as a detailed source on Servo's design and performance, including plans to move Servo code into Gecko.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages
